content.value: During a boiler trial, the dry flue gas analysis by volume was reported as: C02 I I%, CO 0.5%, 02 7%, N2 81.5%. The coal analysis by mass was reported as: C 63.5%, H2 4%, 02 4.5%, moisture 14%, ash 14%. Calculate: (i) Minimum air required to burn 1 kg of coal. (ii) Mass of air actually supplied per kg of coal. (iii) The amount of excess air per kg of coal burnt.
